paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者回忆一次准备普通物品的任务中，某个提醒后感受仍然强烈，后来用了可用的暂停，继续时仍不太自在。他不确定暂停带来了什么变化，也可以让这种不确定保留。记录不能从“暂停过”推断已经平复，更不能确认提醒指向哪段历史；本例不要求查资料、重现提醒或再试一种技巧。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls strong feelings after a reminder while preparing ordinary belongings, an available pause and continued unease on returning. The effect of the pause can remain uncertain. Recording a pause establishes no settling and verifies no history behind a reminder. This scene calls for no evidence search, recreated reminder or trial of another technique.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我想谈的是继续日常活动时的困难；感受的来历暂时不展开；暂停过也不代表问题已解决。”可以只读这张虚构卡，不记录事件或身体感受。听者可以了解现在的需要，不要求证明历史或比较谁平复得更好；卡片不替代既有照护，也不承诺效果。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card can name difficulty continuing an ordinary activity, leave the origin of a feeling private and avoid treating a pause as resolution. Read the fictional card without recording events or bodily sensations. A listener can hear current needs without proof of history or comparisons of who settles better. The card replaces no existing care and promises no effect.

paragraphs.zh: 新增情境与交流卡为费马编辑部原创，可只读，不是治疗、暴露练习或测量证据。原八条、两个主题各四条的六类记录保持不变，未计分不等于没有注意到；有帮助的行动与困难不反向、不合分。四周只是回忆提示，信效度、常模及跨语言等价尚未建立；不核实历史、不判PTSD或复杂性PTSD。全文无需作答，支持不以计数或事件证明为条件；公开分享只含标题与入口，不含回答、计数或私人历史。
paragraphs.en: These additional scenes and conversation cards are original FermatMind Editorial material for optional reading, not treatment, exposure practice or measurement evidence. The eight descriptions and two six-category records of four remain unchanged. Unscored is not did not notice; helpful actions and difficulty are neither reversed nor combined. Four weeks is a recall aid, without established reliability, validity, norms or language equivalence. This content verifies no history and identifies neither PTSD nor complex PTSD. Full guides require no answers; support requires no count or proof of an event. Public sharing includes only the title and entry, without answers, counts or private history.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者回忆想和熟悉的人一起准备一顿普通饭菜，又希望一次交流放慢；后来对一处小分歧意味着什么仍不确定。想接触、需要空间与未知可以并存，不要求选出最“健康”的距离。指南不知道对方是否同意、实际交流怎样或关系是否改变，不以舒适程度认证安全，也不安排新联系来核对。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls wanting to prepare an ordinary meal with a familiar person, wanting an exchange to slow down and remaining unsure what a small disagreement meant. Contact, space and uncertainty can coexist without a healthiest distance to choose. The guide knows neither the other person’s agreement, the actual exchange nor whether the connection changed. Comfort certifies no safety, and no new contact is assigned for verification.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡可以只区分“我希望参与什么”“我希望保留什么空间”“哪些意思仍不确定”。可以讨论虚构例子，不交出自己的记录；听者不必替任何人保证、决定关系去留或要求撤掉边界。是否分享、何时停止均可自行选择，公开指南不是要求谁增加信任或披露的凭据。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card separates desired participation, space to retain and meanings still uncertain. Discuss the fictional scene without your record. A listener need not guarantee anyone’s behaviour, decide whether a connection should continue or ask for a boundary to be removed. Disclosure and stopping stay voluntary; the public guide warrants no demand for greater trust or disclosure.
